summary: Fast moving unvarying bright white light.
description:
Noticed it when opening a window ran and got 10x Vertex binoculars and went out front. From the time I first saw it until I stopped was probably a little less than a minute with about half that time watching through the binoculars. Perfect sphere, no variation in appearance.
It was very bright white like landing lights on aircraft or at least as bright as Jupiter and approaching Venus in brightness. I followed it approximately 90 degrees of its arc. No variation of color or brightness throughout its arc unlike landing lights that would no longer be seen when going away from me. I’ve seen the space station and it was much dimmer and according to the internet its track wasn’t over me at that time.
I got the impression that it was at airliner altitude but no way to judge scale. It was traversing the sky about twice as fast as airliners do at high altitude. Size wise it was about half the size of Venus and almost as bright.
There are lots of commercial and military aircraft overhead (I'm adjacent to Camp Pendleton) and I pay attention to them. I’ve not seen anything like it before. No launches were made at Vandenberg and they leave a contrail anyway.

summary: Abnormal lights, abnormal shape, flying low and slow
description: I was driving on Argonne Ave and noticed two bright lights in the sky and pointed them out to my passenger. As I turned left onto Sunnybrae Blvd, it suddenly shifted and started moving sideways. Then it turned and I could see it had a dark, triangular shaped silhouette. At this point, I realized it could not have been a plane because it was moving at such a slow speed that would be perceived from a plane that was thousands of feet away, but I could see it was clearly much closer than that. I thought it could have been a drone, so I lowered my music and rolled down the window to see if I could hear any drone-like buzzing, but it did sound like a plane that was passing overhead, but at that proximity, it should’ve been much louder than it was. We lost sight of it as I drove to 711 and I could no longer hear it after I got out of the car. It was heading Northeast the last we saw it.

It appeared to us both, that in the cloudy distance, there was a dark shape above the helicopter, barely visible. It's pretty apparent if there's more than one craft flying.

description:

summary: Very fast bright amber light moving north. Faded out a pulsed back many times before disappearing after holding a steady brightness.

I'd say better than 2,000 miles an hour. Before it disappeared over the foothills, it faded out but then pulsed back to full brightness. It did this multiple times before finally going out of view behind the foothills. I've seen the ISS many times. This was moving far faster through the night sky. I just randomly stepped outside and there it was. Weather was clear and calm with a lot of extra light from a very bright moon. After seeing this I had goosebumps for a good fifteen minutes. Definitely not a satellite or ISS or any kind of plane or helicopter. I can't even begin to guess what it could have been.

A plane flew directly by the lights and it was evident I was not mistaken in my judgement of their abnormality.
I have been observing aerial phenomena for nearly 20 years and felt something in the sky before I saw it.

summary: I observed unidentified aerial objects over coastal waters with unusual movement while U.S. Navy aircraft were actively circling
description:

They were roughly at same aircraft altitude as planes coming in to LAX (5,000 ft?). Initially I assumed they were conventional aircraft in the distance, but one light suddenly moved a significant distance from left to right (east to west, parallel to the shore) in less than a second and stopped abruptly, with no visible trail or sound. I couldn’t believe what I was seeing but I saw exactly that. The movement was rapid and hummingbird-like. I immediately checked Flight Radar for flights in the area. FR showed that at the same time this happened, a U.S. Navy P-8 Poseidon aircraft was circling offshore in repeated patterns for over an hour. They were still up there, two hours after I saw the lights. Weather conditions were clear, some light cloudy haze, and the lights were visible only as points of light with no discernible structure.

summary: We saw a red orb fly over the ocean to land being escorted by a helicopter
description:

After approximately five minutes, I brought this to the attention of my two friends. Just at that moment, the helicopter and orb started flying toward land. It was approximately 100 yards away from us and maybe 50 to another hundred yards high.

description:

Walking back home looked at it again and noticed its lighting had changed from what I thought were two or three forward lights to just one and it was traveling slower than normal air traffic – it did not look right. Grabbed smartphone and my wife and I went onto porch facing north. Almost a full moon to our 2 o’clock position with clouds starting to form. Object was higher and to our left of the rising moon and Jupiter, both of which were bright.
No aircraft at that location was on FlightAware. Object now appeared higher. Our naked eyes could see the light appearing to be flickering. Started video recording on smartphone and narrated what we were seeing. Unlike any aircraft or satellite that travels in a straight line, this object kept changing multiple directions in an aeronautical manner not familiar to me. Thought it might be a weather balloon being blown in the atmosphere. Once magnified with the video, it was not a balloon.
It appeared to be one object spinning made of at least two shapes spinning in…

summary: Flash of light, black circle in center of light, then darted off and upwards
description:
I was driving down plant street from the 429. I believe I was facing west. The sky illuminated right above my eye line like a flash of lightening, but it stayed lit in the middle of the sky. Amongst the illumination was a pure black circle. Almost looked like it was just missing light there in a perfect hole. The instant I even realized what I was looking at it darted off at an upward angle leaving a blue white and green looking trail that vanished as soon as it appeared. I’ve lived in Florida my whole life and watch rockets launch all the time but I’ve never seen anything move that fast. It was almost inconceivable. The entire interaction last maybe a second and a half.
It almost looked fake. Like vfx in real time in the sky. There was zero trace of anything that had flown through the sky.

summary: Explanation:  Chinese Lantern - Probable
description:
Orbs moved silently from NW to SE at medium speed in train formation over a period of ten minutes.
I walked onto my pool deck just after midnight and saw two orange orbs moving toward the southeast. No sound, no navigation lights, traveling in a straight line. Slight pulsation in brightness. Called for wife to observe and grabbed my phone for video. Orbs would proceed SE and begin flickering before fading from view. The stream continued for approximately ten minutes, with all following the same behavior as the lead objects, decreasing brightness and fading from view. I consulted Heavens Above website for satellite passes, and of course it was too late at night for any. Checked my Flight Radar 24 app for local radar contacts and found none. They all moved at a speed I would characterize as general aviation speed (I am a pilot), possibly 80-100 knots. No altitude estimate, but they weren't that high, I think. Maybe a couple thousand feet? I captured good video of most of them. The last one observed followed a different, more easterly track before disappearing.
